name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio: Krzysztof's passion for motorsport ignited during his youth, fueled by watching rally legends navigate treacherous Polish landscapes. He honed his analytical skills with a degree in engineering, applying his knowledge to data analysis within smaller racing teams before transitioning to a strategic role. Krzysztof thrives on anticipating track conditions and competitor strategies, making split-second decisions that can drastically alter race outcomes. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to clearly communicate complex information to the pit crew and drivers, ensuring everyone is aligned on the optimal strategy.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Krzysztof is of average height with a slightly wiry build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn copy of 'The Art of War'.
Insists on drinking a specific brand of Polish herbal tea before every race.
Taps his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, often distracting nearby colleagues.
